scope.label: startup-prefix
scope.rationale: The candidate reaches QTask_CreateTask 0x48F7AA and throws inside QTask_RegisterClasses (untranscribed). The prefix before that call is the provable window; the loop/shutdown and the AL spill after the call stay unobserved until QTask registration lands.
scope.unobservable_after: 0x0048F7AA (QTask_CreateTask) — record AL spill/Loop_StatusByte/HardcoreGerman/loop/shutdown as NOT OBSERVED, never as passed
scope.note_pump: Pump exit path now matches retail: exit code is written only when GetMessageA returns 0 (0x48F85F -> 0x48F898), and WM_QUIT leaves the loop unconditionally (candidate quit flag == retail 0x48F898). Tester should encode the retail pump order and exit-code path; remaining source gaps are B3/B4, not the pump.

proven_absences: No UpdateWindow call anywhere in 0x0048F530 (retail executes only ShowCursor(0) 0x48F790, ShowWindow(hwnd,10) 0x48F799, StoreWindowHandle 0x48F7A0).
No branch on RegisterClassA's return value (0x48F5E6 falls through to 0x48F5EC).
No static HWND in 0x0048F530; the only HWND persistence from this block is the StoreWindowHandle write [0x005C8BC4].
No GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN) before GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN); retail does SM_CYSCREEN first (0x48F739), SM_CXSCREEN second (0x48F747).
No MessageBoxA on the normal startup path before the window exists; the only early box is the duplicate-instance box (0x48F8F0 block).
No exit-code write on the normal queue-drain path: the exit local is written only on the WM_QUIT path 0x48F898.
No further loop iteration after GetMessageA returns 0 (0x48F898 goes straight to shutdown).
